question: What consecration and marking procedure enables subjugation of the world?
premises: Consecration is performed a hundred times and more.
A marking action follows the consecration.
The world can be subdued by this procedure.
inference: Having consecrated it a hundred times and more and marked it, one should subdue the world.
uncertainties: The exact meaning of sāgram in this ritual count is uncertain.
plain_english: Having consecrated it a hundred times and more and marked it, one should subdue the world.
